audience: IT and facilities teams that track assets, software licenses and loans in Reftab

useCases.title: Find laptops that are checked out
useCases.text: List assets filtered by location, category or loan. Open one by its asset ID, and search the people who hold loans.

useCases.title: Track overdue loans and loan history
useCases.text: List the current and past loans with a status filter. Read the checkout and return history of one asset for an audit.

useCases.title: Check software license renewals and costs
useCases.text: Search the licenses with status and sort filters. Open one to read its cost, vendor and seats.

useCases.title: List open asset maintenance
useCases.text: List the maintenance records, for example overdue or open work on one asset or location. Open one record by its ID.

useCases.title: Review locations and asset categories
useCases.text: List the locations with their asset counts, and the asset categories. Read one location with its license counts.
